notes.title: New Update: Heart Frames to Decorate Your Screen!
notes.content:
[h3]❤️ Hello, players![/h3][p]We’re excited to share a lovely new update that brings more personality to your gameplay experience:[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🌟 Main Feature[/h3][p]🖼️ [b]Decorative Frame System[/b][/p][list][*][p]You can now enable [b]animated heart frames[/b] on the sides of your screen![/p][/*][*][p]Perfect for adding a cozy and personalized touch to your desktop while playing.[/p][/*][*][p]You can toggle the feature on or off in the game’s visual settings.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🔧 Additional Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]General performance optimizations.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor visual fixes to icons and menus.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]💌 A Thank You Note[/h3][p]This update is another way for us to show how much we care about you!
Thank you for being part of our community. 💖[/p][p]Got ideas for new frame themes? Let us know in the comments![/p][hr][/hr][p]🎮 With love,
The Forgate Games Team[/p]

tags.feature: You can now enable [b]animated heart frames[/b] on the sides of your screen!
You can toggle the feature on or off in the game’s visual settings.
